steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and verifiable project-management experience. Review PMI's specific hour requirements for your background, then gather documentation of your work history. Granite PM Academy's admissions team can help you confirm eligibility before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. Attend instructor-led sessions on your schedule, interact in real time, and build mastery of the PMBOK® Guide framework and exam domains without travel or fixed classroom constraints.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, register directly with PMI, upload your education and work documentation, and pay the associated exam fee. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the application process to ensure accuracy and timely submission.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-prep resources—practice questions, mock exams, and targeted review—to solidify your knowledge. Schedule your official PMP exam through PMI's testing partner and sit for the computer-based test at an approved testing center.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn and report Professional Development Units (PDUs) throughout the standard three-year renewal cycle. Granite PM Academy offers PDU-eligible courses and resources to help you stay current, meet PMI renewal requirements, and advance your career in San Antonio's competitive job market.
